items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: because Paul Bobrand didn't need a trumpet player.

ctx.x: For Frank Ferrari. So, well, he didn't think much of the idea of hiring a trio, so he, I guess he said, well, I think I'll give him something to do anyhow. So, he wanted to see how eager we was to, to, to hold a job. You understand? Yeah. He thought maybe we'd just go there for food. He said, well, I'll tell you what to do. He said, if you want the job, he said, your job start at 12 o'clock at night, you play at 6 o'clock in the morning. I said, well, all right, we take the job. And we did that for about three…
Paramount, yeah. Paramount. We have about ten seconds here to go. Then you joined Bill Matthews.
